name: Igarashi Kaoru
source:
Star Sign: Taurus
Special Skill/Hobby: Cooking, Soccer
Favorite Food: Pudding
Disliked Food: Bitter Food

He passed the S.D.A.F entrance tests along with Tsubasa and was chosen as a new recruit in CUE.
He has a rough personality, but he's actually a kind guy that cant ignore people who need help, even though he complains while helping them.
He chose this job in order to help people.
